oae_challenger.note: Additive block; never overrides any production field. Owner-promoted operating CFB game forecast; forecast only, no bet authority.
oae_challenger.sign_convention: margin = home - away; spread_home = -expected_margin; ladder p = P(side wins by more than k)

settlement_basis.fg: full game, final score INCLUDING overtime; winner is 2-way (no ties); p_home_win + p_away_win = 1
settlement_basis.q1: regulation quarter 1 points only; overtime EXCLUDED
settlement_basis.q2: regulation quarter 2 points only; overtime EXCLUDED
settlement_basis.q3: regulation quarter 3 points only; overtime EXCLUDED
settlement_basis.q4: regulation quarter 4 points only; overtime EXCLUDED

oae_challenger.period_winner_basis: 3-way (home / away / tie): a tied period settles both team contracts NO; tie probability is not emitted, so p_home_win + p_away_win = 1 - P(tie)

excluded.fg_total: PARTIAL: total probabilities over-projected (holdout bias +0.059 toward the over); not emitted

excluded.h1_spread: no gain over the naive split
